description: Read the latest publicly available Founder Signal. The current public registry exposes this read-only operation; disposition writes are not available through this schema.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-generated key for a disposition receipt; required on write operations, not on get_latest.

message_id.description: Public signal message ID returned by get_latest; required for a disposition receipt.

operation.description: Read the latest publicly available founder signal. This operation is read-only.

reason.description: Optional disposition explanation, up to 1000 characters; recorded with challenge/decline/safety-block operations.

name: receive_founder_signal
title: Retrieve or acknowledge a Founder Signal
